text.text_excerpt: Very good, locally owned, neighborhood joint! All three sandwiches and fries were under $30 and the the food came out rapidly. As someone on the industry, I'm glad when your order is cooked FRESH! As it was here. I'm picky when it comes to tomatoes and dressing my sandwich but they nailed it!!! Extra pickles add onions no tomatoes. We ate, we sighed and then passed out after a long extended weekend of work for us all. Will be back soon you guys!!!

Personable staff, clean environment, and good food (MY meal is honey chicken and teriyaki chicken with low mein.) I'm such a regular that the owner starts plating my order when I walk in the door! LOL. My last visit I went relatively late in the day and there was no honey chicken on line. NO problem. The cook fixed some for me in a matter of minutes. I've enjoyed several of the po-boys and the beautifully seasoned fries. Have not been disappointed in any of my many visits but the chicken plate that I got needed a tad more seasoning.

This place was good, not great. The gentleman behind the counter was very knowledgeable and a great conversationalist. However, a little rude calling my wife 'baby' in front of me. I understand 'darling' and 'hon' to be southern terms considered to be polite, but 'baby' was a little too personable for my comfort level. The food was good. I got the Philly cheesesteak which was kind of a cross between a Philly cheesesteak and Burger King's Whopper. It had all the Whopper ingredients inside the bun along with the cheesesteak ingredients inside the bun. The roll it was served on was absolutely delicious, not unlike a Sheboygan hard roll, real hard and chewy on the outside and soft on the insi...
